title: Launch cadence and cross-team publish schedule
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinated, channel-specific schedule and operational checklist for the upcoming tiered product announcement. Scope: blog post, product release notes, targeted customer email (paid/tiered segments), social (company + execs), and a launch webinar with live Q&A. Goal is to ensure a single source of truth for timing, asset ownership, and gating so Marketing, DevRel, Eng, Design, and Support publish in lockstep with graceful fallback if the runtime rollout slips. This ticket owns the publish cadence, final release-note signoff, and pre-flight readiness checks. Deliverables: 1) publish schedule matching deployment windows, 2) release notes draft + change log, 3) marketing asset checklist (images, CTAs, tweet drafts), 4) webinar moderator run sheet and replay hosting plan.

release_notes_summary: Add new publish and routing policies for multi-region deployments; performance improvements for KV cache and batching that reduce median tail latency by ~12%. Known limitations: dedicated autoscale warmup may take up to 90s under cold start—mitigations documented in the notes. Include migration notes for private deployments about minor config changes and compatibility notes for older quantized runtimes.
open_questions: Should GA be gated on Dedicated autoscale telemetry meeting 99.9th percentile SLA? (Eng input needed)
Do we publish a single global blog or region-staggered posts tied to deployment windows?
Which execs will share social posts and what approval lead time is required?
decisions: Publish cadence will be staged: partner preview (select customers) -> partner embargo lift -> public announcement
Release notes will live in the GitHub repo and be mirrored to Confluence for long-term searchability
Webinar will include a live demo and a reserved Q&A slot for SRE to address performance questions
